paper_title: The NANOGrav 15-year Data Set: Search for Signals from New Physics
coupling_convention: d_e, dimensionless (plotted directly on log y-axis)
notes: NANOGrav 15-yr searches for ultralight scalar DM couplings (d_e, d_me, d_mu, d_g, etc.) via pulsar timing. Constraints presented only in Fig. 14/15 (95% CL, plotted vs frequency/mass ~10^-24 to 10^-20 eV) with no numerical values in text/tables, so no (mass,coupling) pairs are extractable. Paper covers MULTIPLE scalar couplings (electron, muon, gluon), making a single coupling_type ambiguous; ScalarElectron chosen per hint. Local DM density assumed 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (Table 1). | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Traced red solid 'Correlated' curve in the d_e panel (top-middle) of Figure 14 of the NANOGrav 15-yr New-Physics paper. x=m_phi [eV], y=d_e (dimensionless). Excluded region is above the curve. Constraints assume ULDM is 100% of DM with rho=0.4 GeV/cm^3. CAUTION: the paper labels this coupling d_e (scalar coupling to photons / alpha variation), which per the task disambiguation corresponds to ScalarPhoton, but the text-analysis hint suggested ScalarElectron; genuine ambiguity between ScalarPhoton and ScalarElectron, hence low extraction confidence. The provided axis calibration (M_sun, 1e-3 to 1e13) corresponds instead to Figure 18 (fifth-force alpha_tilde, a Yukawa/nucleon quantity) and does NOT match the d_e/ScalarElectron hint. The red curve wiggles; values are the smoothed envelope.
